_noteRSplit: R SPLIT INTO R AND R2 (loop 482, user request). Cyclone is two spins, not one: the live wiki (wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Wukong, fetched 2026-08-21) says the first spin runs up to 2 seconds and he may cast it a SECOND time within 8 seconds, which the BIN confirms with RecastWindow 8 and LockoutTimeBetweenCasts 1 beside SpinDuration 2. The two spins are identical in damage - 1/1.5/2% of maximum health (+34.375% AD) every 0.25s, so 8/12/16% (+275% AD) over a full spin, which is exactly TotalDamageTT and PercentHPDamageTT - so R2 is R again, resolving the same calcs through binSpell. The knock-up is once per spin per target and is crowd control, not damage, so it changes nothing here. R itself is untouched: a combo that had one R node still scores one full spin, and the second is now sayable instead of silently absent.
